title: Planning free RPG Maker tutorials and plugins — looking for community suggestions!

posts.author: VegetableDev
posts.body:
Hi everyone! Vegey here.
I recently started planning a small personal/community project for my free time: creating free RPG Maker tutorials, small systems, and plugins for MV/MZ.
The main idea is to study interesting mechanics, UI ideas, and systems from existing games or media, then rebuild them in RPG Maker in a clean, educational, and reusable way.
To be clear, this is not about asset ripping, copying games, or making fangame templates. The goal is to create general-purpose systems that can help other RPG Maker developers learn and build their own projects.
For example, instead of:
“How to make Game X in RPG Maker”
Click to expand...
The idea would be more like:
“How to make a camera monitor system”
“How to make a stalker/chase enemy AI”
“How to make a phone UI”
“How to make a simple card pack/shop system”
“How to make a flashlight and noise detection system”
Click to expand...
Some possible tutorial/plugin ideas I have in mind:
Phone UI for horror, mystery, or modern games
Camera monitor system
Flashlight system
Noise detection and stealth mechanics
Stalker/chase enemy AI
Simple top-down action combat
Retro-style battle UI
Visual novel style message system
Card pack opening system
Improved shop UI
Relationship/affection system
Small quality-of-life plugins for events and UI
I would like these to be useful beyond one specific reference, so people can adapt them to their own original games.
So I wanted to ask:
What RPG Maker systems, mechanics, UI ideas, or plugin concepts would you like to see as free tutorials or community plugins?
Suggestions can be simple or complex. They can be inspired by existing games, movies, anime, or completely original ideas.
I’m mostly trying to understand what would actually be useful for the community before I start choosing what to make first.
Thanks!

posts.author: Jinx Adnix
posts.body:
Oh boy did you ever find the right (Wrong?) person to ask about this...
Your Ideas
Spoiler:
Phone UI for horror, mystery, or modern games
Not a bad thought to be sure, but don't forget to figure out a means to allow reception to change based on location and game progression... Don't forget how many plugins use regions as is. Whatever you make should play nice.
Spoiler:
Stalker/chase enemy AI
Don't forget to include a means to have NPCs run from the player/each other, and a way to allow them to make mistakes. Both random and forced by the player.
My Ideas
Mentioned to someone else, but adding visual dice rolls would be nice. (There are open source things you can import... That's the extent of my knowledge.)
Something that can freeze other events, including combat when the player likes so they can insert proper tutorials would be nice.
There is a growing tend in games where in a party death is permanent, but grants some boon. You could explain not only how to do it, but how to balance it and to what effect.

posts.author: Holder
posts.body:
Something I believe would help people make their game feel like their own would be
menu manipulation.
Tutorials on how to:
Change around the menu.
Move scenes to other locations
Have a picture background rather than windowskin.png
Add or remove scenes.
Remove Gold scene
Add an additional scene, example Quest Completed/Total
Alter existing functions.
Alter actor face graphic to a different size image
Remove or Add actor states, include status icons, remove TP bar
That's just some general thoughts on what I think might help. Make sure you link to where people can view/watch your tutorials when you get going with them.
